With reference to the National Handicrafts Awards conferred by the President for 2023 and 2024, consider the following statements:
1. Handicrafts employ over 32 lakh people, mostly in rural areas.
2. The awards were given only for 2024.
3. About 68% of the workforce in the sector is women.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The awards covered both 2023 and 2024, with 12 Shilp Guru awards and 36 National Awards. The reduction of GST on handicrafts from 18% to 5% is aimed at reaching Rs 1 lakh crore of exports by 2031-32.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q:
With reference to the sculptor Ram Sutar, consider the following statements:
1. He was a gold medallist from the JJ School of Art in Mumbai.
2. He received the Padma Shri in 1999 and the Padma Bhushan in 2016.
3. He designed the Statue of Unity, which honours Sardar Patel.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. He was born on 19 February 1925 at Gondur village in Dhule district and lived to the age of 100.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: Which one of the following Indian films has been shortlisted for the Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards?
opts: Laapataa Ladies, directed by Kiran Rao
Girls Will Be Girls, directed by Shuchi Talati
questions.why: It is among 15 films shortlisted from 86 eligible countries. Academy members who opt in for the nominations round must watch all 15 films.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: The Har Ghar Museum campaign, which won a PRSI National Award, was run by which one of the following?
opts: Archaeological Survey of India, New Delhi
National Museum Institute of Art History
questions.why: The NCSM under the Ministry of Culture invites people to share photos, videos and stories of their personal collections to build a digital archive of living history.

questions.subject: Art & Culture
questions.q: The Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, noted for its titanium-clad flowing form, is the most acclaimed work of which one of the following who passed away recently?
questions.why: Gehry won the Pritzker Architecture Prize in 1989. He used software originally made for fighter jets and drew inspiration from fish and Japanese temples.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the Viksit Bharat G RAM G Act, 2025, consider the following statements:
1. It bars any pause in work during the peak farming season.
2. It replaces MGNREGA and raises the statutory guarantee of work to 125 days.
3. Funding is shared between the Centre and the States in a 60:40 ratio, with special ratios for some regions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It includes a 60-day pause during peak farming seasons so that farm labour remains available. Under MGNREGA the Centre paid 100% of unskilled wages.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the Atal Pension Yojana (APY), consider the following statements:
1. It was launched on 9 May 2015 for the unorganised sector.
2. Pension begins at the age of 50 years.
3. It is open to citizens between 18 and 40 years who have a savings account in a bank or post office.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The pension begins at 60 years, so the first pensions will start from 2035. Gross enrolment crossed 8.34 crore by 31 October 2025.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the Trade Enablement and Marketing (TEAM) initiative, consider the following statements:
1. It is a Central Sector Scheme under the RAMP programme.
2. It leverages the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) to help micro and small enterprises.
3. It targets to support 5 lakh enterprises, of which 50% are women-owned.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The outlay is Rs 277.35 crore for 2024-27. It offers digital storefronts, payment solutions and logistics support.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the PM MITRA textile parks, consider the following statements:
1. They will be developed through the Engineering, Procurement and Construction model of the Government.
2. The scheme was announced in the Union Budget for 2021-22.
3. The three parks with finalised DPRs are at Lucknow, Kalaburagi and Navsari.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: They will be developed in the Public-Private Partnership mode using the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer framework. The scheme has an outlay of Rs 4,445 crore and the DPRs total Rs 5,567 crore.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the PAHAL scheme for domestic LPG, which one of the following is correct?
opts: The cylinders are sold at a subsidised price at the gas agency
The subsidy is paid in cash by the distributor to the user
Subsidy is credited directly to the consumer's bank account
The consumer receives a voucher to adjust it against the bill
questions.why: All domestic cylinders are sold at a uniform retail price. PAHAL helped to block ghost, multiple and inactive connections.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the National Makhana Board, consider the following statements:
1. Its first meeting was chaired by the Secretary, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
2. It supports a Central Sector Scheme of Rs 476 crore for Makhana development.
3. Seed supply is to be consolidated through institutions in Bihar.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. SAU Sabour and CAU Samastipur in Bihar will supply seed, and NRC Makhana at Darbhanga will help train trainers.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the Tex-RAMPS scheme, consider the following statements:
1. It has a total outlay of Rs 305 crore from 2025-26 to 2030-31.
2. It targets mainly the export of cotton yarn.
3. It is funded entirely by the Ministry of Textiles.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It targets research, data systems, innovation support and capacity development in the textiles and apparel ecosystem.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: On the winter solstice, 21 or 22 December, the Sun is overhead at which one of the following?
questions.why: The Sun is overhead at 23.5 degrees south. It gives the shortest day and longest night in the Northern Hemisphere.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to Project Cheetah in India, consider the following statements:
1. Cheetahs have been brought from Namibia, South Africa and Botswana.
2. The animals were released at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh.
3. International Cheetah Day is observed on 4 December.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The day was marked from 2010 by Dr Laurie Marker, founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund, in honour of the cheetah Khayam.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to International Mountain Day, consider the following statements:
1. It is observed on 11 December.
2. The United Nations General Assembly recognised it in 2003 after the International Year of Mountains in 2002.
3. Its 2025 theme was about glaciers and their importance for water, food and livelihoods.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. About 15% of the world's people live in mountain regions, which hold nearly half of the world's biodiversity hotspots.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the Champions of the Earth award of the UN Environment Programme, consider the following statements:
1. Supriya Sahu of Tamil Nadu received it in 2025.
2. It was given for climate action based on integrated governance and nature-based solutions.
3. UNEP is headquartered in Geneva.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: UNEP is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. Sahu is Additional Chief Secretary of the Department of Environment, Climate Change and Forests of Tamil Nadu.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the foreign honours received by the Prime Minister during the three-nation tour of Jordan, Oman and Ethiopia, consider the following statements:
1. Ethiopia awarded him the Great Honour Nishan of Ethiopia, its highest award.
2. Oman awarded him the Order of Mubarak Al-Kabeer.
3. He was the first global head of state or government to receive that award.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Oman awarded the Order of Oman, its highest civilian honour. The Order of Mubarak Al-Kabeer is Kuwait's honour. The visit to Muscat coincided with 70 years of diplomatic relations.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to persons with disabilities in India, consider the following statements:
1. The term 'Divyangjan' has been used since 2015.
2. The International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on 3 December.
3. Unique Disability ID cards are issued to access benefits.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The National Awards for the Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities 2025 were presented on 3 December 2025.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q: Shivraj Patil, who passed away recently, served as which one of the following in the Lok Sabha from 1991 to 1996?
questions.why: He was the 10th Speaker of the Lok Sabha. He later served as Union Home Minister from 2004 to 2008 and resigned after the 26/11 attacks.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the MoU between the Ministry of Social Justice and the Ministry of Rural Development for De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNTs), consider the following statements:
1. It brings DNT self-help groups into the DAY-NRLM framework.
2. A dedicated cadre called DNT Sakhi will support about 30 families organised in three SHGs.
3. More than 5,000 DNT SHGs formed under the Development and Welfare Board will be taken into the framework over three years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The Board is the DWBDNC under the Ministry of Social Justice, and the MoU also aims for credit linkages and diversified livelihoods.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the joint venture agreement between BEL and Safran Electronics & Defence for HAMMER, consider the following statements:
1. BEL will do only the design while all production stays in France.
2. HAMMER is a smart precision guided air-to-ground weapon.
3. The joint venture company will have 50:50 shareholding.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Production transfer will be gradual with BEL responsible for final assembly, testing and quality assurance, and the target is 60% indigenisation of key components. HAMMER suits platforms such as Rafale and Tejas.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the C-DOT Centre of Excellence at IIT Roorkee, consider the following statements:
1. C-DOT is an R&D centre of the Department of Telecommunications.
2. It will focus only on legacy 2G network equipment.
3. The centre will focus on wireless communication, quantum technologies, cyber security and AI applications.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It aims at 5G/6G, RF sub-THz integrated circuits, mmWave beamforming and V2X communication, and at academia-industry synergy.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q:
With reference to the loan agreements signed by India with the Asian Development Bank worth over USD 800 million, consider the following statements:
1. They include a loan for a skills programme in Rajasthan.
2. They include USD 500 million for the Maharashtra Power Distribution Enhancement Programme for Agricultural Solarization.
3. They include a loan for the Indore Metro Rail Project in Madhya Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The skills programme is the Gujarat Skills Development Programme of USD 109.97 million. A technical assistance grant of USD 1 million was also given for the SWIFT wetland and fisheries project in Assam.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the MoU between NHAI and Reliance Jio on a telecom-based safety alert system, consider the following statements:
1. Travellers will get advance warnings on their phones near accident-prone stretches and fog-affected areas.
2. The system will be integrated with the Rajmargyatra app and the helpline 1033.
3. It needs new roadside hardware to be installed along the highways.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: It uses existing telecom towers and Jio's 4G and 5G network, so it can be deployed quickly without additional roadside hardware. Alerts are sent by SMS, WhatsApp and high-priority calls.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q:
With reference to the Global Energy Leaders' Summit 2025 held in Puri, consider the following statements:
1. It was organised by the Government of Odisha.
2. It concluded with a Draft Puri Declaration and four MoUs.
3. One MoU set up a Green Hydrogen Centre of Excellence in Odisha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The theme was 'Powering India: Sufficiency, Balance, Innovation', and the talks covered small modular reactors, green hydrogen and digital grid security.

questions.subject: Polity & Governance
questions.q:
With reference to the MoUs signed by the Ministry of Labour and Employment with Microsoft and by the Ministry of MSME with Amazon, consider the following statements:
1. Microsoft will encourage over 15,000 employers to join the National Career Service platform.
2. The Amazon MoU supports artisans under the PM Vishwakarma Scheme.
3. The PM Vishwakarma Scheme was launched on 17 September 2023.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. The scheme provides skill training, toolkits, credit and support for the guru-shishya parampara, and Amazon's Karigar initiative will showcase handmade products.

questions.subject: Sci & Tech
questions.q:
With reference to the C-130J maintenance facility to be set up by Tata Advanced Systems and Lockheed Martin, consider the following statements:
1. It is a Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul facility for the IAF's C-130J fleet.
2. The IAF operates a fleet of 30 C-130J aircraft.
3. The groundbreaking ceremony took place in Bengaluru.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: The IAF operates 12 C-130J aircraft. Construction is due to finish by the end of 2026 and MRO operations to begin in early 2027.

questions.subject: IR
questions.q:
With reference to the United Nations Alliance of Civilizations (UNAOC), consider the following statements:
1. It was launched by the UN in 2005 on the initiative of Spain and Turkey.
2. It aims at intercultural dialogue to counter polarisation and terrorism.
3. Its 11th Global Forum was held in Riyadh in December 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: All three are correct. India's delegation was led by the Secretary (East) of the MEA and stressed 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' and 'Sarva Dharma Samabhav'.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited, with which BEML signed an MoU, is described as which one of the following?
opts: A public sector bank that lends to ports only
A development finance institution for shipping
First NBFC focused on the maritime sector
A guarantee fund for inland waterways
questions.why: BEML signed it for financial support to maritime manufacturing. BEML also signed a tripartite MoU with HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering and HD Hyundai Samho Heavy Industries for port cranes.
